slides.title: Apostrophes: one rule, ^^two traps^^
slides.badge: They test this on nearly every module

slides.title: It's vs its
slides.body: Say "it is" in the sentence. If it works, write *it's*. If it does not, write *its* — no apostrophe, even though it shows ownership.

slides.title: Plural possessives
slides.words: the students' scores · the children's books
slides.body: First ask: how many owners? One team → team's. Two teams → teams'. The sentence always tells you the number — find it before you pick.

slides.stem: The two ______ strategies could not have been more different.
slides.prompt: The word "two" is doing all the work. Comment your answer.

slides.title: B — teams'
slides.body: The word "two" means plural owners: teams. The apostrophe goes after the s: teams'. "Team's" is the bait if you missed the word *two*.
